blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY, South Cotabato — Some 16 local government units in Soccsksargen or Region 12 have received a total of P520 million in national government assistance to help rebuild communities damaged by the magnitude 7.8 earthquake that struck off the coast of Sarangani province in June. President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. led the ceremonial turnover of the funds under the Disaster Rehabilitation and Reconstruction Assistance Program (DRRAP) at Malacañang Palace last Nov. 5.
